Checking for additional background processes beyond the main runners. Considering webhook async queues, notification emails, thumbnail generation, and SSE hub. Noting that SSE hub is not a worker.

Only s3presign is started by the server via startBackgroundRunners. memopayload.Runner exists but is never launched as a background worker; RebuildMemoPayload runs inline during CreateMemo and UpdateMemo. internal/scheduler is unused by the server. Checking whether the webhook PostAsync queue is started by the server.

Server.startBackgroundRunners only launches s3presign. Webhook workers initialize through package init() instead of the server startup path.

The s3presign runner uses a time.Ticker every 12 hours, plus a RunOnce at startup. The memopayload runner is not launched as a background worker. The internal/scheduler package is unused. I am checking the runner directory for additional files beyond memopayload and s3presign.

memopayload.Runner exists but is never invoked as a background worker; RebuildMemoPayload runs inline instead. The only runner explicitly started by the server is s3presign.

q28.
s3presign — `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (plus `RunOnce` at startup)
unused infra: `internal/scheduler` is never started by the server; `server/runner/memopayload` exists but is not launched as a background runner (`RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline from memo handlers)

`Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` is the only runner start path: it constructs `s3presign.NewRunner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`), runs once immediately, then `Run` on a 12-hour ticker. Webhook HTTP workers in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` start in `init()` off a channel, not from that server runner loop.
